statement: ∀ (N D : ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ), let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let P := (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Coprime p N); (∑ p ∈ P, η p * Λ (N - p)) = (-(∑ d ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => Nat.Coprime d N), μ d * Real.log (d : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ P.filter (fun p => p % d = N % d), η p)) + (-(∑ p ∈ P, η p * ∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors (N - p)).filter (fun d => D < d), μ d * Real.log (d : ℝ)))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 中央反射 · RD-7001 · 指定和的反射除数精确拆分
plain_statement.en: New route · Central reflection · RD-7001 · Exact reflected-divisor split for a designated sum

brief.zh: 把 Λ(N−p)=−∑_{d∣N−p} μ(d) log d 按 d≤D 与 d>D 精确拆分；对 (p,N)=1 的素数每个短除数自动满足 (d,N)=1 且 p≡N (mod d)，写成按模 d 单位剩余类分组的精确恒等式。
brief.en: Expand Λ(N−p)=−∑_{d∣N−p} μ(d) log d and split at d≤D vs d>D; for primes (p,N)=1 every short divisor is coprime to N and fixes p≡N (mod d), yielding an exact residue-class decomposition.
